hook: THEY ONLY CALL WHEN THEY NEED *MONEY
title: F27 · atm · Everybody Needs Something
lines: He has not taken his shoes off yet.
Fees. Groceries. A new phone screen.
Lying awake, he wonders if they would notice him at all, without the wallet.
The next evening he came home with nothing in his hands. A bad day. Not one sale.
She did not check his pockets.
His wife had kept his tea hot. His son moved over on the sofa.
Nobody asked for anything. They had only ever wanted him home.
You are not what you provide. You are who comes through the door. That is sadhana.
